In a 1F1B (one-forward-one-backward) pipeline with p stages and m micro-batches, each stage idles for (p−1) micro-batch slots of forward plus backward time, while it does useful work for m slots.

- Ideal time per stage: m · (t_f + t_b)
- Bubble time per stage: (p−1) · (t_f + t_b)
- Total step time: (m + p − 1) · (t_f + t_b)

Bubble fraction = (p−1)/(m + p − 1) = 7/(32 + 7) = 7/39 ≈ 0.1795

This assumes uniform stage times and ignores communication, and that 1F1B has the same bubble as GPipe (it just reduces activation memory).
